status: five delivered concepts for user selection; not approved production assets

variants.name: 旧布行者
variants.hook: 尖兜帽与散开的旧布下摆，最接近孤独旅人的气质。
variants.design: Subject design — THE LINEN WANDERER: a slender living cotton lamp-wick inside a weathered soot-grey linen cowl. Strong tall asymmetric pointed hood and narrow triangular cloak silhouette, about three-and-a-half heads tall, short frayed cloak hem above feet, no billowing scarf. Head is a dark hollow hood with one tiny warm teardrop ember set deep within as its face, NOT a human face and NOT a pair of glowing eyes. A clearly visible braided wick neck descends from the hood into the chest; two delicate dark braided-fibre arms emerge from distinct sleeves, small simple hands, short wrapped-fibre legs. One hand gently raised toward the pale backlight, the other relaxed. Warm inner edge subtly lights a few loose flax fibres around the hood. Sparse sewn seams and a single darned patch. Familiar wandering-child readability but unmistakably made from an old lamp wick. The ember lives inside the hood, no flame on top.
variants.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: one original protagonist concept painting for a poetic 2D puzzle game about feeding light to an immense sleeping creature in an abandoned garden. This is one of five distinct exploratory character directions, not a final approved character.
Primary request: a tiny LAMP-WICK SPIRIT, itself an animate wick-being rather than a human carrying a lamp. Quiet, vulnerable, curious, gently hopeful. It must have two usable small hands and two grounded feet suitable for walking, jumping and turning mirrors.
Style/medium: draw from the intricate hand-drawn storybook visual language of Gorogoa, translated into transparent watercolor washes, fine slightly irregular pencil/ink contours, visible cold-pressed paper grain and restrained botanical detail. Hand-painted 2D illustration, not a 3D render. Lighting takes inspiration from LIMBO: layered mist, strong dark silhouettes, soft pale backlight, long grounded shadow, crisp readable edge against haze. Keep character material and construction visible in the shadows. Restrained near-monochrome charcoal, blue-grey and muted olive environment; a small warm amber ember is the principal color accent. Poetic fairytale, no horror or violence.
Scene/backdrop: a simple mossy stone garden ledge at tiny-creature scale, a single oversized blurred leaf with dew at an edge, distant ruined greenhouse arch dissolved into luminous fog. Background subordinate, no other characters or creatures.
Composition/framing: square canvas, a SINGLE large full-body three-quarter character facing slightly to the right, all limbs visible, standing on the ledge, character approximately 65–70 percent of canvas height. Clear silhouette, breathing room all sides, quiet slight forward lean. No inset images, no turnaround sheet, no panels.
Constraints: original character design; no copied game protagonist. No text, labels, lettering, logos, watermarks, equipment, weapons or handheld lantern. No giant expressive cartoon eyes, no glossy toy shading, no photorealism, no neon glow. Flame small and gentle, never obscuring shape; important silhouette must remain readable at small gameplay size.

variants.name: 白蜡初生
variants.hook: 圆润蜡壳与头顶小火苗，最偏童话与新生。
variants.design: Subject design — THE WAX NEWBORN: a short, round, asymmetrical pear-shaped creature made of old ivory candle wax, with no clothing, hood or lantern. About two-and-a-half heads tall. A small round head merges organically into a plump wax torso; a single bent black cotton wick grows from the crown and bears a tiny warm amber flame. Two tiny soot-coloured pinprick eyes, no mouth or nose. Distinct short wax arms with mittenlike useful hands and two clearly separated stout wax legs; one foot a little forward. Layered translucent drips form a natural ruffled shoulder edge and a few softened scars, not gore. A fine warm light seeps through a thin patch in the chest showing the darker wick inside. Asymmetrical wax silhouette, fragile handmade candle material rather than a smooth vinyl mascot. Very restrained ivory highlights under charcoal-blue shadow. Its little body is the candle.

variants.name: 玻璃藏光
variants.hook: 透明灯腹包住灯芯，内部结构与光影最突出。
variants.design: Subject design — THE GLASS-HEART KEEPER: a delicate walking antique lamp vessel, narrow domed upper silhouette and gently bulbous pear-shaped glass torso. The body is a handblown smoke-tinted glass oil-lamp chimney with a simple tarnished brass collar and base, open top shaped like a small tulip lip, NOT a square hanging lantern, no carry handle. Inside the transparent glass, a living dark braided wick stands as the tiny spirit, its upper tip glowing with a low amber flame. Two small simple dark eyes sit on the wick just BELOW the flame and are visible through the glass. Two thin cotton-cord arms with small useful knot-hands emerge beside the collar, and two short bent cord legs with planted knotted feet extend below the base, organically handmade rather than robotic. About three heads tall. Uneven softly distorted watercolor glass edges, one old fine crack on the rim, a hint of smoky residue, enough clear glass to read the internal wick. Warm inner flame softly illuminates the inner glass and a little brass edge. Elegant vulnerable silhouette, no external clothes, hat or backpack, no machinery, no mechanical joints.

variants.name: 枯叶守夜
variants.hook: 宽阔叶披肩与纤细灯芯四肢，和花园联系最强。
variants.design: Subject design — THE LEAF NIGHTWATCHER: a very small dark living wick-body wearing a broad folded dried-leaf mantle, reminiscent of a resting moth's silhouette but with NO functional wings, NO antennae and NO ability to fly. Its broad short mantle has two overlapping heart-shaped curled leaves with delicate hand-inked veins, smoky grey-olive and muted umber. A little almond-shaped cotton-wick head rises ABOVE the leaf collar, two simple dull ivory seedlike eyes and a tiny exposed ember at the top of the head. The head is NOT inside a pointed fabric hood. Two long fine braided wick arms and small knot hands are plainly visible below the sides of the short leaf mantle, and two thin legs with grounded curled-fibre feet below it; proportions small head, broad shoulders, narrow lower body. One leaf edge has a repaired stitch. The collar cups a subtle warm reflection from the head ember, while most of the broad leaf silhouette stays dark against fog. Botanical fairytale spirit, never an insect or fairy; no fluttering fabric or ribbons.

variants.name: 余烬绳偶
variants.hook: 全身由灯芯绳编成，最直接体现“灯芯成精”。
variants.design: Subject design — THE BRAIDED EMBER: a bare, wiry little humanoid spirit made ENTIRELY from one continuous thick cotton lamp-wick cord, with no clothing, no container, no wax and no leaves worn on the body. Distinctive large hollow oval loop of braided wick forms the head, leaning slightly to one side, the background faintly visible THROUGH its dark central opening; a tiny ember sits at the knot at the very top of the loop. No human face, no glowing dot eyes. Compact double-loop chest knot, clear uneven rope arms ending in tiny loop hands capable of grasping, longish thin braided legs ending in flattened knotted feet; the arms and legs are separate and anatomically legible, no excess appendages. About three heads tall, bent knees and gentle inquisitive posture. Charred upper fibre tips transition into pale old flax at lower body, tiny amber seam of warmth within the chest knot. Spare unusual elegant silhouette, tactile frayed fibres drawn selectively with fine ink and watercolor. The head-loop and body-knot must be unmistakable at a glance, a humble discarded lamp wick that has learned to stand.

refinements.prompt:
Edit this concept artwork. Keep the same single small full-body braided lamp-wick spirit, walking-capable two arms and two legs, garden ledge, foggy greenhouse background, paper grain, muted palette, tiny warm ember, overall composition and quiet fairytale mood.
Replace ONLY the character's head and adapt the upper-body proportions slightly: completely remove the enormous open oval rope ring. Its new head is a SOLID compact asymmetrical seed-shaped knot of old cotton wick, densely woven, about one quarter of the full character height. A single short burnt wick tip emerges from the top with a very small amber flame. The head has a simple narrow warm seam across the front suggesting quiet awareness, not big glowing eyes. NO hole through the head, NO hollow ring, NO large neck loop. Round, closed, soft but unusual head silhouette. Keep the chest knot with a small ember inside, the useful loop hands, and two distinct planted knotted feet. Make limbs slightly shorter to create a modest three-head-tall body. Fibre rendering should be selected hand-inked curves and translucent watercolor brush strokes with visible paper texture; less photographic strand-by-strand detail. Preserve the character as made entirely of wick, without clothing, wax, glass, or extra props. Warmly mysterious and newly alive. No text or extra panels.
